newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam academic supports yokel theory.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam academic supports yokel theory.

text.p: Research by a Vietnamese academic has found that 75 percent of the country's brainpower is in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, an official daily said on Friday.
Around 90 percent of Vietnam's 75 million population does not live in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City.
The English-language Vietnam News said the disturbing evidence had emerged from a recent survey by an academic, whom it named as Dr Ho Bat Khuat.
The paper expressed concern that the uneven distribution of intelligence was hindering economic development.
Khuat could not be contacted for comment on Friday.
Popular belief in Vietnam -- expressed in the term 'nha que', or country bumpkin -- holds that grey matter is unevenly distributed.
